description: How and when merchants get their money. Six questions are left.
problem: Merchants are paid by hand once a month, and they cannot see what is coming.
solution: Payouts run on a schedule, and each one comes with a statement.

design.label: What this feature is
design.summary: A payout schedule, a balance the merchant can see, and a statement with each payout.
design.detail: Four screens are drawn. The questions below are the only things still open.

screens.cap: The payouts page a merchant sees.

decisions.title: Payouts go only to a bank account
decisions.detail: No cards or wallets in the first release.

decisions.title: Merchants cannot change the payout day themselves
